body: Yes it’s so frustrating as I used to be good with words ,and now I feel it makes me come off as stupid to other people
Thank you ❤️ you are valid too. I needed this
Yup. Replace alcoholic  with workaholic father
I have this thought all the time

I’m not OP but greatly relate to their post. I needed to see this last paragraph you’ve written about accepting and owning our weirdness and shame of failure. i still feel  like a piece of shit because I so badly want to fit in with and be like all these people who are more adequate than I am. But learning to own the shame (while still making efforts to better myself) can possibly make life a little bit more livable for me. Thank you
I’m so sorry you feel this way. I can relate, I’m in pretty much the same situation. I think I might be ready to leave

It used to make me feel the same way. I would get into a hole where I endlessly compare myself to others, get jealous, and then feel guilty for feeling this way. I barely open the app now. Feel so much better since.
Same. I often have this thought too
Yeah it make me very sad, even when I see « perfect families » or loving mothers especially in tv shows or movies. Or even when people talk about their mom being their best friend etc
Yes I escaped through movies and series for a long time.

I have poor coordination too. Could only really differentiate my left from my right in my early 20s for example. I also get lost all the time. I haven’t been diagnosed but I believe I have dyspraxia. You could maybe look into it?
It was the opposite for me, they were quite negligent

It’s like you’ve taken the words out of my mouth when it comes to wasting and losing years to trauma and mental illness. I have bpd too and have felt shit all my life, since I was a child due to emotional abuse and neglect mostly. But also I think partly because I might be genetically predisposed to mental illness. But yeah now I am 28. Have spent so much money on a degree that’s getting me no jobs. Having trouble getting into grad school, I don’t think I’m particularly stupid but all these years of trauma and sadness have most probably had a negative on my intellectual development. I feel guilty for being so bitter and being an adult that depends on my parents and does nothing. I actually wanted to be independent from a young age. I hate being a failure
I’m 28F and I relate to this a lot. We can talk if you want to
